references.text: Jesus predicts persecution of his disciples, which is similar to what he says in Matthew 10:18.
Mark repeats Jesus' warning about persecution, also mentioned in Matthew 10:18.
Luke also mentions Jesus' prediction that his followers will be brought before kings and governors, parallel to Matthew 10:18.
The Acts of the Apostles shows the fulfillment of Jesus' words in Matthew 10:18, as Paul testifies before kings and leaders.
Paul's experiences as an apostle, where he stands before kings to testify, reflect Jesus' words in Matthew 10:18.
